summary: Procedure steps should have one action each, start with an imperative verb, have a summary for long procedures, and describe expected output within the step rather than as separate steps.
questions: How should I write procedure steps in docs?
Should expected output be its own numbered step?

answer_card.title: Writing procedures
answer_card.answer_md: One action per step, starting with an imperative verb. Summarize long procedures up front. Put expected output in the step or as unnumbered text after it, e.g. "1. Run the `ansible-playbook` command. The output displays a list of completed tasks."
